reviews.title: Tired
reviews.text: There has to be a better way to post caches in certain locations. But then I find out that they have not been maintained or missing and it becomes a huge, huge huge waste of time. This app should automatically hide or filter out any caches that are not current by DEFAULT

reviews.title: Paying for "harder" caches
reviews.text: I used to use this app all the time, but deleted it for a few years with some life changes. I just redownloaded it and it wants me to pay to see caches that are super simple and I have done before, but someone labeled them as hard? A cache that is a tackle box behind a main bench on a path we walk all the time. Locked. A cache i revisited two days ago? Locked. My favorite cache that I do a hike to visit on my birthday every year? You guessed it, locked. Hundreds of caches I have done before that are not difficult at all (because I physically can not do the actual hard ones) I can no longer report that I completed, revisited, that they have moved, or are missing.

reviews.title: Complete Trash
reviews.text: This app needs an expert mode. There’s no reason why someone with thousands of finds needs to dismiss irritating condescending popups like we don’t know what we’re doing. This app also uses a ridiculous amount of data for something to be used in the field. Expect irritating spinning circles as it struggles to load the smallest of things. There’s also no back button so if you open a geo tour and look at a cache, there’s no way to go back to viewing the geotour. This app is pure developer negligence and Groundspeak knows this. They withhold access to certain features from their API such as the messaging center so that users of better apps are forced to also have this one to perform basic functions.
